overview: Based on the published agenda, the Port Chester Board of Trustees was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address zoning amendments for two development projects, discuss e-bike and scooter safety, consider term limits and parking fee adjustments, and take action on several resolutions including capital projects and budget amendments.
actions: Scheduled to hold public hearing and vote on Resolution 0.5 regarding 155-157 Irving Avenue zoning amendment
Scheduled to hold public hearing and vote on Resolution 0.75 regarding 157 Westchester Avenue zoning amendment
Expected to vote on resolution designating polling locations and hours for March 16, 2027 Village Election
Expected to vote on resolution authorizing intergovernmental agreement with New York State for Endpoint Protection and Response Services
Expected to vote on resolution authorizing updated Equitable Sharing Agreement with Drug Enforcement Administration
Expected to vote on establishing Capital Project #2026-308 for traffic improvements at Westchester & Bowman Avenue ($200,000)
Expected to vote on budget amendment for Police Emergency Services Vehicle Repair ($11,600)
Expected to vote on budget amendment for Capital Project #2021-212 Computer Hardware/Equipment ($124,000)
